memoryRule: a pending mouth connection remains geometry-neutral; release fuses two untouched remote routes into a new path, notch, bend, and width; four fusions persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch drags between two distinct mouths; ArrowRight chooses the pair and Enter or Space commits; bind control is equivalent; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases

changedRule: A mouth-to-mouth connection is inert while pending. Only a complete pair spends the event by fusing two untouched remote routes; the visited mouths and temporary path do not persist.
